definition: The group of words that name the groups the site map files its places under, so the rail and the front door's map read alike.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`nav-group` holds the groups the site map files its places under", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
